chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 456: Ji Ning Shatters the Shaoyin Clan's Eight Immortal Formation in One Charge
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning unleashes a devastating self-created sword technique, shattering the Shaoyin clan's Eight Trigrams Wandering Dragon Formation and instantly slaying two Celestial Immortals in a single charge.
og_title: Desolate Era: Ji Ning Obliterates Two Celestial Immortals in One Blinding Strike
og_description: The Shaoyin clan's confidence turns to ash as Ji Ning, wielding a new sword art, breaks their formation and claims two immortal lives in a single, breathtaking assault.
twitter_title: Ji Ning just broke an 8-Celestial Immortal formation and killed 2 of them in one charge. #DesolateEra
twitter_description: Outnumbered and surrounded, Ji Ning unveils a new sword art to shatter the Shaoyin clan's best defense.

lore_anchors.definition: A balanced offensive-defensive formation that manifests a golden trigram diagram and a coiling dragon, used by the Shaoyin clan's Immortals.
A purely defensive formation with extremely high fortitude, abandoned by the Shaoyin clan in favor of a more balanced tactic.
A top-tier teleportation divine ability created by Patriarch Subhuti specifically for Ji Ning, granting him extreme speed and evasion.
A peerless, primordial divine ability that transforms the user's hands into nigh-indestructible weapons, capable of shattering magic treasures and ichor.
The immortal energy core of a Celestial Immortal, whose severe damage provides the in-story justification for the enemy's weakened state in this battle.
The highest grade of magic treasure, imbued with Pure Yang power; Ji Ning's Starseizing Hand-empowered palms are compared to this tier.
